notes: All 43 source and 48 target IDs are partitioned exactly once.
Both prohibition waws (s011, s033) are rendered by that rather than and, and a waw standing in the clause takes whatever connective the ASV writes for it (rules 14, 55); neither that is added.
מִבֵּית fuses to within with the following לַ unrepresented under rule 40, and the assimilated article still takes the written the under rule 12 — the same division the chapter uses at vv. 12 and 15.
כַּפֹּרֶת is headed on mercy under rule 31, since the ASV never writes seat alone for the word; heading on seat was the competing reading and is named in the unit note.
